notes.title: Who Are Pablo's Companions? 🐶
notes.content:
In the Grapple Dog franchise, we see a number of characters make an appearance with Pablo - but who are they? 

In Grapple Dog, we learn Pablo is part of a team looking for ancient artifacts across his world, Partash; hidden by an ancient inventor. Now, in Cosmic Canines, the team is on another hunt; but what for?

This team involves the Professor, a highly intelligent bird who is the leader of Pablo's team, and the teammate who seems to be the only one not thinking about burgers! 🪽

Also on the team is Toni, a sensible rabbit who wants the best for Pablo, even if it means venturing into the unknown🐰

[b]But who is the mysterious newcomer Luna? Not long to wait until you find out...✨[/b]

notes.title: Meet Luna 🔫
notes.content:
[h2]So, Who is Luna?[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2278790/Grapple_Dogs_Cosmic_Canines/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44548969/a4ecd8db432fd91fa5538987cf4845f0fd900bad.gif[/img][/url]
[b]Luna[/b] is one of two playable characters in Grapple Dogs: Cosmic Canines. She has a Grappling Hook and a gun - her inclusion introduces projectile weapons into the gameplay of Grapple Dog! She can also pick up new weapons throughout the game. 

Luna’s home dimension has been invaded and destroyed by Vyr, the ultimate villain of this game. Since then, she has been working with The Beyonders as an Agent of The Beyond. She wants revenge on Vyr for destroying her dimension, and hopes that by defeating him she can finally go home. Whereas Pablo is a novice to this world of interdimensional universe-saving, Luna is an experienced professional!

Luna is stoic, brooding, cool, and tries to keep herself guarded at all times. She tends to be blunt and direct when speaking, without much respect for niceties or social convention. She can become aggressive if she doesn’t get her way, so other people are scared to talk to her a lot of the time. She also has an arrogant streak - a strong belief in her own abilities, and disdain for anyone that gets in her way! She’s driven by a very strong sense of morality and purpose.
[h3]And yes, you can pet her (although she may not be the happiest about it)[/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2278790/Grapple_Dogs_Cosmic_Canines/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44548969/5f29296b635af37e9fe71773f6f47087aa32c20a.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Grapple Dogs: Cosmic Canines is releasing September 12th 🐶
notes.content:
[h3]Grapple Dogs: Cosmic Canines, the highly anticipated sequel to the critically-acclaimed 2D action-platformer Grapple Dog, will launch on September 12th, 2024.[/h3]

In Grapple Dogs: Cosmic Canines, players will join Pablo and Luna, an intrepid duo of pups, as they swing, bounce, and blast their way through interdimensional landscapes on a mission to save the cosmos! Prepare for action-packed levels, challenging puzzles, and adorable canine capers in this vibrant and unforgettable adventure. Check out the Grapple Dogs: Cosmic Canines release date trailer below, featuring colourful, eye-catching animation from Jellybox Studios!

[h3]Watch the Grapple Dogs: Cosmic Canines Release Date Trailer here![/h3]
[previewyoutube=H8QtKTNatcA;full][/previewyoutube]

Featuring challenging platforming full of innovative twists and fresh abilities like fire-dashing and magnetic grabs, Grapple Dogs: Cosmic Canines allows players to propel themselves through a menagerie of breathtaking pixel-art landscapes with exhilarating speed and control. Every world is brimming with new and unique levels, hidden collectibles and secret areas to uncover, providing surprises across the galaxies. 

Players can sharpen their claws for two pawsome ways to play! For players who love to swing and sling? Beloved pupper Pablo returns with his trusty hook and acrobatic grappling skills ready to zip to new heights. More of a shoot-first pup? Players can unleash their inner gunslinger with mysterious newcomer Luna's arsenal of weaponry, adding a thrilling new combat mechanic to the mix. 

Time Trial modes offer players an added challenge, racing against the clock (and maybe otherworldly competitors!) to prove they're the ultimate top dog. Memorable boss battles introducing epic canine combatants bring players unforgettable showdowns for their interdimensional pups, as they swing, shoot, explore and wag their tails for the ultimate canine adventure!
